scope: Per spacecraft; housekeeping telemetry destined for Earth, excludes lunar PNT broadcast
notes: OPTIONAL REVERSE ENGINEERING SCENARIO. Payload and Structures are calibrated channel-level hypotheses reproducing PDF targets. NOT independent validation, not owner-confirmed. The 12 bps Payload residual is not an actual identified sensor. Default inputs remain unchanged.

subsystems.name: payload_housekeeping
subsystems.source: PDF §2.7.3 (p.14): 100 bps continuous housekeeping. Names clock lock status, clock cell temperatures and SSPA RF power; the PDF gives no channel count, bit depth or cadence.

components.name: clock_lock_status
components.source: PDF §2.7.3 names lock status; 8-bit word and 1Hz assumed

components.name: clock_cell_temperatures
components.source: PDF §2.7.3 names clock temperatures; count, bit depth and cadence assumed

components.name: sspa_rf_power
components.source: PDF §2.7.3 names SSPA power; resolution and cadence assumed

components.name: unresolved_payload_status_budget
components.source: 12 bps calibration residual ONLY; no evidence of three actual 4-bit sensors

subsystems.notes: Hypothesis: 8+64+16+12=100 bps. Last 12 bps is unresolved calibration residual, NOT a confirmed physical sensor. Scenario only, not baseline.
subsystems.owner_todo: PAYLOAD OWNER: provide for clock lock status, clock cell temperatures and SSPA RF power the number of channels, bits per sample and sampling interval, and say whether 100 bps includes packet headers or other channels.

subsystems.name: structures_mechanisms
subsystems.source: PDF §7.5.3 (p.52): 32 bps. Documents 8 deployment switch bits, 2x16-bit SADM encoders, 2x16-bit HGA resolvers and 6 RTDs at 0.2 Hz. Cadences of switches/encoders/resolvers and RTD bit depth are not given.

components.name: structural_rtd
components.source: PDF §7.5.3 6 RTDs at 0.2 Hz; 10-bit resolution inferred

subsystems.notes: Hypothesis: 4+8+8+12=32 bps. PDF specifies channel counts and RTD cadence; other sampling cadences and RTD resolution are assumptions.
subsystems.owner_todo: STRUCTURES/MECHANISMS OWNER: provide the sampling interval of the deployment switches, SADM encoders and HGA resolvers, the RTD bit depth, and whether 32 bps includes headers.
